# ProgressTracker

The steps of a journey, each done, current or upcoming. Every item renders as a link (`href`), a button (`onClick`) or plain text, in that order of precedence; `disabled` items take neither. `status` alone drives how a step looks — a `visited` item still needs `onClick`/`href` to be reachable again.
